answer: One-Time Attestation Ledger. Each identity must submit a unique hardware-signed attestation containing a fresh nonce derived from a physical source, such as a measured terrace temperature trace, hashed into a pigment-like entropy signature. A sparrow-tagged audit node verifies the nonce was never previously used on-chain. Reusing any nonce invalidates the identity and forfeits its registration record. An attacker must therefore acquire and physically sample a new distinct source for every identity, making each fake agent cost one unique sensor reading plus hardware signing overhead.
